messages:
carla: quick thread  need to lock down the notification contract for "soft degrade" events. running into ambiguity between using HTTP codes, headers, and telemetry.

ben: tl;dr: prefer keeping semantics in HTTP status where possible. customers + infra tooling rely on 4xx/5xx/429 buckets.

mike: infra standpoint: we can add telemetry events, but we need clear schema + cardinality controls. otherwise dashboards get noisy.

sophia: SDKs will need deterministic surface. options i see: 1) 2xx + X-Runtime-Warn header + body.error 2) 2xx with final control-frame for streamed responses 3) return 207/499 custom-ish code (not great).

anna: product: want customers to clearly see degraded correctness and have programmatic ways to fallback. white-label customers also want tenant-scoped badges.

carla: current problematic case: model safety limiter truncates output but we still return tokens. operators want to trigger routing fallbacks for heavy degradation, but we don't want false-positive falls for single short requests.

ben: thought: keep primary failure buckets same (5xx/429). For soft-degrade, emit a structured telemetry event with fields: event=soft_degrade, code, severity, route, model, tenant_id, request_id. then: make routing/fallback.evaluate that event stream.

mike: agreed but we need a low-cardinality key for alerts. else we'll see hundreds of unique request_ids. propose alert key = (route, code) aggregated over time window plus distinct tenant count threshold.

carla: can you sketch promql/rules?

mike: sample rule (pseudo):

```
sum by(route,code) (rate(runtime_soft_degrade_events_total[5m])) > 5
AND
topk(5, count_unique_over_time(tenant_id[10m])) > 2
```

(we'll make it prettier in the PR)

console-ux: Console wants a three-state badge: ok / soft-degraded / hard-failed. clicking badge should show sampled request examples (scrubbed) and link to runbook. also want a time-series of soft_degrade_rate vs 5xx_rate.

ben: note on SDKs/backwards compat: older SDKs expect 2xx as success and won't surface banners. we should make the runtime emit both header and telemetry event so older SDKs at least have telemetry in logs (server-side) and newer SDKs show UI.

sophia: SDK API proposal: Response.degradation = { present: bool, code: string, severity: string, message: string } and a hard flag Response.shouldFallback = severity >= medium. We'll gate the parsing behind client-version header so rollout controlled.

carla: quota implications: if soft_degrade happens because we hit model concurrency limits, do we count tokens consumed? should tenants be billed fully for truncated responses? finance needs guidance.

anna: product note: customers expect to be billed for tokens that were delivered; but if output truncated early for quality/safety maybe pro-rate? complicated. we'll loop in finance/legal.

mike: routing action: add an internal tag on telemetry events called routing_hint with values {none, fallback_recommended, immediate_failover}. that will let automated routers decide without changing HTTP codes.

ben: ops: make sure fallback/scale-up uses routing_hint=immediate_failover only when severity=high AND distinct tenant spread > threshold. prevents noisy single-tenant autoscale blips.

carla: we need a standard event schema. draft: 

```
{
  "event": "soft_degrade",
  "code": "SOFT_MODEL_LIMIT",
  "severity": "medium",
  "route": "/v1/generate",
  "model": "redwood-rl-1",
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "routing_hint": "fallback_recommended",
  "sample": "[scrubbed prompt]",
  "request_id": "r-abc123",
  "ts": 1797654322000
}
```

(carried as structured proto in telemetry pipeline, not as nested json in our RFC)

ben: policy point: don't use 2xx+body.error as the single source of truth. require telemetry event emission as mandatory for any soft_degrade. runtime PR should fail CI if event not emitted.

sophia: SDKs: we'll add opt-in parsing flag and bump client-min-version. also expose an event hook so customers can register onDegrade(callback).

console-ux: for sampling: sample at most N=50 requests per route per 10m, prefer unique tenants, redact PII. show anonymized prompt hashes and truncated response.

mike: infra follow-ups: 1) implement telemetry producer + low-cardinality indexing 2) add routing consumer that can trigger fallback decisions 3) implement prom rule and dashboard panel. i'll open tickets.

carla: rollout plan suggestion: alpha (internal only, event+header but SDKs not required), beta (SDKs opt-in + console badge), GA (server-side enforce telemetry emission + SDKs default parsing).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: carla created doc soft-degrade-contract-v1 in /docs/rfcs (link in thread). reviewers: @mike @ben @sophia @console-ux.

anna: i'll gather finance on billing edge and draft customer-facing FAQ explaining billing for truncated responses.

carla: decisions so far: 1) telemetry event required 2) header optional but recommended 3) routing_hint field to control fallback 4) console sampling + badge 5) SDK API to expose degradations behind version gate.

ben: added note: ensure alerting uses aggregated counts + tenant spread to avoid noisy alerts.

carla: ok great. i'll write RFC and include prom rules and example UI mockups. will tag with rollout phases. thanks all.
